R01: Keep workspace, Project, Product, model, canonical-home and runtime identities distinct.
R02: Resolve all eight areas through selected source references and independent candidate manifest homes.
R03: Keep parent and local authority scopes distinct, with exact inherited model revision.
R04: Allow only context-budget and operator-note configuration; prohibit semantic overrides.
R05: Preserve exact source pins, Project/Product lineage and Goal membership posture.
R06: New model/local revision requires a successor binding and exact transition preimage.
R07: Reconcile uncertain effects before redispatch; do not claim universal rollback.
R08: Profile validation does not grant adoption, admission, runtime permission or Product benefit.
R09: Use shared capability operations and one shared runtime target by default; a workspace does not require its own capability/runtime instance.
R10: Resolve every call against explicit workspace, Project, scope and profile revision. Sharing a runtime does not merge state or authority.
R11: Workspace-specific behavior can use the shared runtime. Dedicated runtime targeting is a separate explicit choice, with no installation or code copying implied.
